newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda Motor up on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Honda Motor up on bargain hunting.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd shares were up in early Monday afternoon trade on bargain-hunting inspired by the yen's stability at around 115 yen to the dollar, following the Group of Seven summit, brokers said.
At 0335 GMT, the shares were up 60 yen at 3,270.
"There were comments uttered at the summit calling for Japan to refrain from increasing its trade surplus, but everything was within expectations," a trader at foreign brokerage said.
"Investors feel a bit easier about buying the shares, especially since the yen is a bit weaker against the dollar."
